algorithms.euclid_Q: rational Euclidean PRS of (P, dP/du); read deg<=1 remainder as associate of Sres_1
algorithms.euclid_Fp: field Euclidean PRS over F_p; zero-locus agrees with classical PSC_1
algorithms.classical: sympy.subresultants for absolute Sres_1 and PSC_1
algorithms.bezout: extended Euclidean algorithm: s1*u+s0 = a*P + b*P_u with a,b in Q[u] (pointwise specialization)

principal_subresultant_coefficients.PSC_0: Res_u(P, P_u) = H * G (T2R4 exact quotient circuit)
principal_subresultant_coefficients.PSC_1: s_1 when deg Sres_1 = 1; vanishes with Res=0 iff deg gcd(P,P_u) >= 2 on D(ell)

identities.membership: Sres_1 lies in the ideal (P, P_u) as an R[u]-linear combination (Bézout/subresultant)
identities.on_D_s1_generic: when deg gcd = 1 and s1 != 0, the unique common root is u = -s0/s1 in the quotient

structural_equivalence.statement: On D(ell) with Res_u(P,P_u)=0: s1=0 <=> deg_u gcd(P,P_u) >= 2

binodal_vs_cuspidal.binodal: gcd has two distinct roots => two distinct double roots of P; P_uu generically nonzero => open point if other gates pass => NONUNIT witness
binodal_vs_cuspidal.cuspidal: gcd has a multiple root => mult >= 3 root of P => P_uu = 0 at that root => killed by P_uu gate

expansion_status.reason: same densification barrier as T6; evaluation oracle sufficient for directed sections
expansion_status.accepted_by_workorder: exact sparse polynomials OR exact straight-line circuits

agreement_with_T6_circuit.note: T6 sealed circuit description; this packet recomputes independently and matches zero-loci
